title: GTA 6 Cops Now Have K-9 Dogs: Rockstar's Demo Pinned Jason 🐕 #Shorts
description:
Edge magazine (issue 430) played an unscripted GTA 6 demo with Rockstar North co-head Rob Nelson: a stolen motorcycle, a near-invisible spike strip at night, and a K-9 unit pinning Jason down after a botched robbery. Rockstar hasn't said whether dogs appear in all pursuits or only some missions. Sources: Edge 430 via GamesRadar, Beebom, ComicBook.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
